meta.notes: In-repo curated stub for SMART_PIPELINE. Not a live web crawl, not official licensed measurements, not a RAG product. Typical fan-print / display-scale proportions and print-tech cross-links only.

characters.name: stormtrooper helmet

features.name: dome
features.notes: Upper dome; keep wall ≥ 1.6 mm. Display scale unless the user asked 1:1 / wearable.

features.name: visor
features.notes: Brow visor slot — through or deep recess; do not knife-edge the rim.

features.name: neck_ring
features.notes: Lower neck opening. Wearable 1:1 uses the helmet_mask chart (head circ), not this display OD.

notes: Typical fan-print trooper lid proportions for planner use — not an official kit.
1:1 wearable (~230×270×280 mm) exceeds the P2S 256³ bed; default to the display scale that fits, or split / designate a larger stub machine.
sources: Curated display/1:1 bands from common FDM cosplay helmet prints (in-repo stub).
Wearable fit: lib/wearable-sizes.ts helmet_mask chart (EN 960-style head circ).

characters.name: vader helmet

features.name: faceplate
features.notes: Lower face / cheek assembly; keep mouth vents as slots ≥ 2.5 mm.

features.name: neck_shroud
features.notes: Rear neck shroud. 1:1 height will not fit P2S Z.

notes: Typical fan-print vader lid — not official licensed geometry.
1:1 (~250×300×310 mm) misses P2S on Y and Z; display scale is the default plan.
sources: Curated display/1:1 bands from common FDM cosplay helmet prints (in-repo stub).

characters.name: iron-man helmet

features.name: shell
features.notes: Closed clamshell helmet. Faceplate can be a separate solid if the user asks for a hinge.

features.name: eye_slit
features.notes: Narrow eye bar — keep ≥ 2.5 mm opening if through-cut.

features.name: jaw
features.notes: Lower jaw / cheek. Optional faceplate joint uses joints.ts hinge clearances.

notes: Typical fan-print stark-style lid — not official licensed geometry.
1:1 is close to the P2S 256 mm Y limit; display scale is the safe default.
sources: Curated display/1:1 bands from common FDM cosplay helmet prints (in-repo stub).

characters.name: spartan helmet

features.name: visor
features.notes: Gold-visor recess or through opening; leave a printable rim.

features.name: ear_caps
features.notes: Side ear caps — union to the shell, ≥ 1.6 mm attachment.

notes: Typical fan-print spartan lid — not official licensed geometry.
1:1 (~240×280×280 mm) exceeds P2S Y/Z; display scale is the default plan.
sources: Curated display/1:1 bands from common FDM cosplay helmet prints (in-repo stub).

characters.name: saber hilt

features.name: grip
features.notes: Hollow grip; wall ≥ 1.6 mm. Sit on z=0 (emitter up or pommel down).

features.name: emitter
features.notes: Emitter bore ≥ 2.5 mm if through. Leave a blade-socket recess, not a knife edge.

features.name: pommel
features.notes: Pommel cap. Optional 1/4-20 style boss is a 6.5 mm hole with 0.3 mm clearance.

notes: Typical fan-print hilt envelope — not official licensed geometry.
1:1 length (~280 mm) misses P2S Z if printed standing; default printable is 240 mm standing or lay the hilt on X.
sources: Curated display/1:1 bands from common FDM prop hilts (in-repo stub).

tech.name: PLA
notes: Default P2S everyday material. Use printers.ts PLA auto-best (advisory, not a LAN write).

tech.name: PETG
notes: Tougher than PLA; strings if wet or a few degrees too hot. Dry the spool.

tech.name: PA / nylon
notes: Hygroscopic. P2S has no active chamber heater — keep the door closed. Advisory preset only.

tech.name: ABS
notes: P2S has no active chamber heater — keep the door closed and use internal circulation.

tech.name: TPU
notes: Print slowly. Soft TPU can struggle through AMS feed paths. Keep walls ≥ 1.6 mm; do not knife-edge flex features.

tech.name: 0.4 mm nozzle / 0.2 mm layer
notes: P2S default is a 0.4 mm nozzle and 0.2 mm advisory layer height (printers.ts). Walls stay ≥ 1.6 mm (4× nozzle).

tech.name: joint clearances
notes: Use lib/joints.ts P2S / 0.4 mm-nozzle radial/axial tables. Do not invent tighter gaps.

tech.name: P2S build volume
notes: Default printer is Bambu Lab P2S at 256×256×256 mm (lib/printers.ts). Oversize designates a stub alternate (K1 Max / H2D / Prusa XL), it does not silently crop.

tech.name: print-in-place
notes: Print-in-place: one print, separate solids, documented radial/axial gaps. Never union the pin, lid, rotor, ball, or snap hook.

tech.name: split for bed
notes: When 1:1 exceeds 256³, prefer a planned split or a designated larger stub machine over a crushed scale — unless the user asked for a miniature.
